heading: North American Wetlands Conservation Fund; availability of fines or forfeitures
lead: In fiscal year 1992 and thereafter, amounts received during the immediately preceding fiscal year under section 707 of title 16 as penalties or fines or from forfeitures of property or collateral, to remain available until expended.

notes.heading: Prior Similar Provisions
notes.text: Provisions similar to those in this section were contained in the following prior appropriation acts: Pub. L. 102–381, title I, Oct. 5, 1992, 106 Stat. 1381. Pub. L. 102–154, title I, Nov. 13, 1991, 105 Stat. 995.
